item.title: Dairy breeding information event taking place in Cavan
item.description: A dairy breeding information event taking place in Cavan this evening. Progressive Genetics are hosting the event in the Errigal Country House Hotel. Items on the agenda include SBI updates, female selection strategy, new sires available, herd performance examples and maximising calf-to-beef value. Advertisement Progressive Genetics says that this event could be useful for farmers ahead of the breeding season. The event is getting underway at 7.30pm tonight.

item.title: Cavan Lidl to close this week and be re-built
item.description: Lidl on the Ballinagh Rd in Cavan is to close on Saturday and re-open in the summer. The supermarket giants are to demolish the Cavan store and rebuild it. The Ballinagh Road retail store was one of the first Lidl stores to open in the country 23 years ago. Under their new plan Lidl want to build a new supermarket with ancillary off-licence sales on the 0.9 Hectares site. The plans will see the demolition of the existing single storey Discount Foodstore measuring c. 1,596 sqm gross floor space.

item.title: Works on new playground at St Aidan's NS underway

According to James Rudden design work is now complete and he is hopeful that the new playground will be fully complete by mid-February. 78 students attend the local school and he says this safe and inclusive space is much needed as it will enhance children’s play and active time. item.title: Upgrade confirmed for Ballybay Wastewater Plant
item.description: A planned upgrade has been confirmed for the Ballybay Wastewater Treatment Plant. Cathaoirleach of the Ballybay-Clones MD Sinead Flynn described this as a positive and much-needed investment for Ballybay. Cllr Flynn says these upgrades are vital to protect local rivers and waterways as the existing plant is not currently meeting its required discharge standards.
